# ESPN Sports Data API

Comprehensive sports data scraper covering 21+ leagues including NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college sports, European soccer, UFC, F1, and more. Provides scores, standings, rosters, player stats, news, and search capabilities.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.espn_sports_data_api import ESPN
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceNotFound` | The requested athlete or team ID does not exist in the specified league (404 response) | `athlete_id` |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.

> **Note.** Some params accept an enum whose corresponding output field is raw `str`/`list` (the wire value isn't bound to the enum). Enum members never compare equal to raw strings — compare such output values against `member.value`, or use plain string literals.
